-पः 
__1 Throwing or tossing up; पक्ष्मोत्क्षेप [[Me. 49.]] 
__2 That which is thrown or tossed up; बिन्दूत्क्षेपान् पिपासुः [[M. 2. 13.]] 
__3 Sending, despatching. 
__4 Throwing away, rejecting. 
__5 Vomiting. 
__6 The region above the temples (dual).

a. One who throws or tosses up, who or what elevates or raises; उत्क्षेपकग्रन्थिभेदो करसंदंशहीनकौ [[Y. 2. 274.]] 
-कः 
__1 A stealer of clothes &c.; वस्त्राद्युत्क्षिपत्यपहरतीत्युत्क्षेपकः [[Mit.]] 
__2 One who sends or orders.

__1 Throwing upwards, lifting or tossing up; अतिमात्रलोहिततलौ बाहू घटोत्क्षेपणात् [[Ś. 1. 29.]] 
__2 Throwing upwards, regarded by the Vaiśeṣikas as one of the five karmans q. v. 
__3 Vomiting. 
__4 Sending away, despatching. 
__5 A kind of basket for cleaning corn; a kind of stick for threshing corn. 
__6 A fan. 
__7 A measure of sixteen Paṇas.
